affected_system: municipal capital planning, debt, grants, reserves, procurement, and asset delivery
alternatives: add targeted redundancy around the largest failure modes in municipal capital plan under fiscal and delivery stress
select an adaptive robust portfolio across severe scenarios for municipal capital plan under fiscal and delivery stress
pair correlated fiscal, cost, schedule, asset, and hazard simulation with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Budgets, obligations, appropriations, encumbrances, expenditures, schedules, and assets are reconciled.
All fiscal scenarios separate nominal, real, committed, contingent, and modeled amounts.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: apply current continuity provisions to municipal capital plan under fiscal and delivery stress.

constraints.description: The capital portfolio and municipal finance stress test must respect declared minimum continuity and safety thresholds across severe scenarios.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: chief financial officer and capital planning director
decision_question: Which portfolio remains affordable and service-protective under revenue, rate, cost, delay, failure, and disaster shocks?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The capital portfolio and municipal finance stress test must respect declared minimum continuity and safety thresholds across severe scenarios.
independence_key.decision_object: municipal capital plan under fiscal and delivery stress
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for municipal capital plan under fiscal and delivery stress passes documented checks for scenario ranges, dependence, failure rates, recovery, intervention performance, and sensitivity.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: correlated fiscal, cost, schedule, asset, and hazard simulation
independence_key.primary_outcome: scenario-weighted critical service and fiscal threshold breach

intended_claim: A versioned stress-test design for comparing declared alternatives affecting municipal capital plan under fiscal and delivery stress, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: scenario-weighted critical service and fiscal threshold breach
distributional gap in scenario-weighted critical service and fiscal threshold breach
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not present synthetic fiscal paths as audited forecasts, ratings, defaults, or observed losses.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for municipal capital plan under fiscal and delivery stress passes documented checks for scenario ranges, dependence, failure rates, recovery, intervention performance, and sensitivity.

title: Stress-test the capital plan under fiscal and delivery shocks
transportability_risks: Accounting, tax authority, debt limits, grants, procurement, labor, and markets differ.
Historical delivery and cost relationships may shift under inflation or policy change.
